LineFromPoints: The line through 2 points A, B.
Circumcircle: The circle through 3 points A, B, C.
CircleWithCenterThroughPoint: The circle with center A passing through point B.
CircleWithRadius: The circle with center A and radius equal to the distance |BC|.
IntersectionOfLines: The intersection of 2 lines l, m.
InternalAngleBisector: The internal angle bisector of angle BAC.
PointReflection: The reflection of point A in point B.
Midpoint: The midpoint of line segment AB.
PerpendicularProjection: The perpendicular projection of point A on line l.
PerpendicularLine: The line passing through point A and perpendicular to line l.
ParallelLine: The line passing through point A and parallel to line l.
SecondIntersectionOfTwoCircumcircles: The intersection other than A of circles ABC and ADE.
SecondIntersectionOfCircleAndLineFromPoi: The intersection other than A of line AB and circle ACD.
IntersectionOfLinesFromPoints: Intersection of lines AB and CD.
PerpendicularProjectionOnLineFromPoints: The perpendicular projection of point A onto line BC.
PerpendicularLineAtPointOfLine: Perpendicular line to line AB passing through A.
PerpendicularLineToLineFromPoints: Perpendicular line to line BC passing through A.
ReflectionInLine: The reflection of point A in line l.
ReflectionInLineFromPoints: The reflection of point A in the line through B and C.
ExternalAngleBisector: The external angle bisector of angle BAC.
PerpendicularBisector: Perpendicular bisector of line segment AB.
ParallelLineToLineFromPoints: Line parallel to line BC passing through A.
ParallelogramPoint: Reflection of point A in the midpoint of BC.
IsoscelesTrapezoidPoint: Reflection of point A in the perpendicular bisector of BC.
MidpointOfOppositeArc: The midpoint of the arc BC opposite A on the circumcircle of ABC.
MidpointOfArc: The midpoint of the arc BC containing A on the circumcircle of ABC.
CircleWithDiameter: The circle with a given diameter.
TangentLine: The tangent line at point A of the circumcircle ABC.
LineThroughCircumcenter: The line through point A and the circumcenter of ABC.
OppositePointOnCircumcircle: The point lying opposite to point A of the circumcircle of triangle ABC.
NinePointCircle: The Nine-Point circle of triangle ABC.
IntersectionOfLineAndLineFromPoints: The intersection of line l with the line through A and B.
